notes:
TCC Website 0.14.8: the main part of each page is marked for screen readers

- New feature "Main part of each page marked for screen readers": adds
  role="main" to Divi's main-content box (between the header and the
  footer) on every page a visitor sees, so screen readers can jump past
  the header and menu. Nothing on the page looks different. Fixes
  PageSpeed's "Document does not have a main landmark".
- It leaves a page alone that has no such box or already has a main part,
  and never runs in the admin or the Divi editor.
- Help tab, AI prompts, notes and rollback steps updated. New test file;
  254 tests pass on PHP 8.3.
